contract_origin: reviewed public issue and associated SDK behavior; NOT automatic standards/authority inference

stream_terminal_delivery.authority_scope: only local streamed tool fixture; cancellation must have bounded terminal/cancel propagation (1.5s research bound)

inflight_logical_task_not_reissued.authority_scope: only pending logical task scheduling admission; does NOT guarantee exactly once external tool
inflight_logical_task_not_reissued.identity_requirement: logical task ID, never Python object identity

approved_tool_result_persisted.authority_scope: only locally executed human-approved tool, session persistence; requires verified durable call/result IDs
approved_tool_result_persisted.identity_requirement: same exact call_id in persisted call/output

output_guardrail_fail_closed.authority_scope: only streamed output guardrail ordinary exception; forbid accepted final output
